description: Twelve entry points. The first four, the two series guard entries, the two governance-change notice entries and the two owner-acts gate entries are ON by default with a documented opt-out; the two pending-asks gate entries run in observe mode by default. SessionStart (compact|resume|clear|startup): control-anchor re-injection (compaction-survival); among live anchors the one the starting session last wrote (.claude/anchors/.owners.json) ranks first, and a session with a session id that wrote none gets a pointer instead of the HEAD, naming the session that did (a crash restart has a new session id, so it reads the file the pointer names); opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0. SessionStart (resume|compact): the stale skill-body check, read from the session transcript; one line per plugin whose last-served skill body came from an older cached version than the installed one, naming both versions and the fix; silent when every body is current or served from outside a plugin cache. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_STALE_BODY_CHECK=0. PostToolUse (Write|Edit|MultiEdit): a size warning when a write to an open anchor leaves its HEAD over the injection budget or within 10% of it, plus the self-ignoring .gitignore in the anchors directory and the record of the writing session as the anchor's owner in .claude/anchors/.owners.json (replaced atomically); silent on every other write; it shares the SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0 opt-out. UserPromptSubmit: the feedback-debt nudge, read from the session transcript and delivered once per session as one line of additional context on an owner-typed prompt (never on a hand-back or notification, and never a Stop block); it stays silent unless a feedback-targets file resolves, so an install with no registered tools never sees it. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=0. Every no-op path returns zero with no output. See the plugin README for the exact settings block each opt-out goes in. Pending-asks gate (two entry points sharing one script and one switch), in observe mode by default: UserPromptSubmit empties the per-session ledger when the prompt is owner-typed (a new turn; a task notification, subagent hand-back or peer message leaves it); Stop records the asks in last_assistant_message and, at a stop with nothing in flight, records the earlier asks of the turn the message dropped, once per ask, as an observed event; with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=on it also returns them as additionalContext in UTF-8 (never decision: block). Ledger under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/final-block-gate/. SESSION_WORKFLOW_FINAL_BLOCK_GATE=0 turns it off; `python hooks/final_block_gate.py --health` prints the counts. Series guard (two entry points sharing one script and one switch): PostToolUse on Bash|PowerShell records, per session, the repository of a `gh pr create` whose stdout carries a github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n> URL; PreToolUse on Bash|PowerShell denies a second `gh pr create` in a repository that already holds a recorded PR of the session, unless the command carries KEEL_SERIES=<existing series file or spec> or KEEL_SERIES=none:<reason>. Log under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/series-guard/. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_SERIES_GUARD=0; SESSION_WORKFLOW_SERIES_GUARD=observe logs the would-be deny without output. Governance-change notice (two entry points sharing one script and one switch), ON by default: SessionStart (startup|resume|clear|compact) records the SHA-256 and modification time of the governed CLAUDE.md (SESSION_WORKFLOW_GOVERNED_HOME, else CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude) only when the session has no baseline yet, so a compact or resume cannot absorb a change; UserPromptSubmit, owner-typed or synthetic, compares the hash and, when it changed, returns one line of additionalContext naming the file, the time it changed and the instruction to re-read it before the next act, then records the new hash, so each change is announced once. Baselines under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/governance-notice/. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_GOVERNANCE_NOTICE=0. Owner-acts gate (two entry points sharing one script and one switch), ON by default: UserPromptSubmit records the text of the latest owner-typed prompt per session (a task notification, subagent hand-back or peer message leaves it); PreToolUse (Bash|PowerShell|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) denies a write to the governed CLAUDE.md, settings.json or settings.local.json (the governed home: SESSION_WORKFLOW_GOVERNED_HOME, else CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude), a claude plugin install/update/uninstall/enable/disable or marketplace add/remove/update, setting a user or machine environment variable (setx, SetEnvironmentVariable), or a git config --global write, unless one sentence of that prompt names the act's object with an act verb (no earlier negation or condition, not a question); a shell command that writes a governed file is logged, never denied. The deny reason tells the agent to put the act to the owner in the final block, framed, with its side effects. Every decision appends a line to CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/owner-acts-gate/log.ndjson. SESSION_WORKFLOW_OWNER_ACTS_GATE=0 turns it off; =observe logs without denying.
